description: The Codex body extractor (read.bodyField = developer_instructions). Codex sub-agents are pure TOML with no file body; their markdown prompt lives in the triple-quoted `developer_instructions` field. The walker yields that field as the node body, so the universal markdown-link extractor plus the lens-gated at-directive run over it: the three agents' prompts produce six resolved edges (@mentions between agents + markdown links to the docs). A TOML-only corpus still yields a connected graph.
